d.ko:
*** This game is only available in Chinese ***
《仙剑奇侠传》是由大宇资讯所制作的一款国产单机中文角色扮演计算机游戏。本作是《仙剑奇侠传》系列的第一部作品，主题是“宿命”。故事以中国古代的仙妖神魔人鬼传说为背景，以武侠及仙侠为题材，宿命为主轴。

rv.t: I haven't played for long, but this game is amazing! There is a fan translation, and a guide on installing it (literally just copy + pasting files and renaming three files) . …
I would say this is the best wuxia rpg video game ever. If you don't mind the outdated graphic, its gameplay is very appealing.
I get there's a lot of nostalgia for this game, but I think the devs are lazy with this steam release. You can literally download this game free from the internet and use SDLPAL or DOSBOX yourself. …
